purpose: Teach: エディション/マウント/薄型/最速/ユーザビリティ/ポテンシャル/ゼネコン/ウエイト

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、限定エディションの偽造販売を取り締まりますね
lines.en: The police crack down strictly on counterfeit limited-edition sales, don't they.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact observation, slight rising inflection at the end. Conversational, like noting something obvious. Warm but not invested.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、職員間のマウント行為を厳しく注意されますね
lines.en: The police give strict warnings about staff members one-upping each other, don't they.
lines.style: Same steady rhythm, but a touch of gentle humor underneath. Still observational. Light and even-keeled.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、薄型武器の所持にも注意されますね
lines.en: They're careful about officers carrying concealed weapons too, aren't they.
lines.style: Continuing the same neutral, factual cadence. No urgency. Just moving down the list. Tone stays warm and companionable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、最速で現場到着を目指されますね
lines.en: They aim to arrive at the scene as fast as possible, don't they.
lines.style: Still measured, but a hint of respect creeping in on this one. Not slower, just slightly more weight on the words. Still collaborative in delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市民通報フォームのユーザビリティを改善されますね
lines.en: They've improved the usability of the citizen report form, haven't they.
lines.style: Slight tilt toward mild appreciation here. Still matter-of-fact, but the observation lands a little softer. Like noticing something well-done.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、若手警官のポテンシャルを引き出されますね
lines.en: They really bring out the potential in younger officers, don't they.
lines.style: A touch warmer now. Still even-paced, but there's a flicker of genuine approval. Not overplayed—just a natural shift toward something commendable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、ゼネコンの談合事案にも対応されますね
lines.en: They handle bid-rigging cases involving major contractors too, right.
lines.style: Returns to steady, factual delivery. Slightly more weight—these are serious cases. Respectful rhythm, no breathlessness. Professional acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査のウエイトを重大事件に置かれますね
lines.en: They put real investigative weight behind the major cases, don't they.
lines.style: Quieter, more grounded finish. Slower pace. Settled conviction underneath—this one matters. Slight trailing-off, like trusting the listener to understand why.
